$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFDT (AIP France, chart dated 2024-01-25): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Tarbes - Laloubère

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: Simultaneous use of both grass strips prohibited.
All TKOF or LDG is suspended when a glider is immobilized on the half side of the glider RWY at less than a half width of the common limit.
Pilots must check that their ACFT performance allows the overflight of the road "RD 935" located near THR 08 with a margin of at least 50 ft.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Close attention is advised due to possible glider activity to select the fitted QFU.
Not home-based pilots must consult special temporary instructions on the website www.aerobigorre.org/infopilote and register on it.
The registration is valid for 12 months and must be reregistered in case of changes in these instructions.
QFU 080° ARR and QFU 260° DEP: without entry clearance in CTR LOURDES, stay East of the Odos water tower visual reference point.
Recommanded caution considering the proximity of CTR LOURDES and TMA 1 PYRENEES in order to avoid any entry in class D airspace without clearance.
Possible parachuting on AD (n°330), avoid airfield overhead depending on real activity known on Pyrénées Info.
QFU in use on request dropping aircraft pilot or dropping ground base.
PJE (NR 334-1) TARBES QUARTIER LARREY - FL 120 - SR-SS except SAT, SUN and Public HOL - Activity according to protocol - Actual activity known on PYRENEES INFO.
SR-SS except SAT, SUN and Public HOL - Activity according to protocol - Actual activity known on PYRENEES INFO.
